messages:
zara: Heads-up — hitting a reproducible instability on the AWQ 13B bring-up. Symptoms: bursty latency spikes, some requests looping identical tokens, and occasional 502 from dedicated pool. Repro at scale when group_size=64 + activation-quant enabled. Posting quick traces and eval deltas below.
liam: ugh. Which model variant / quant config exactly?
zara: model: redwood/open-13b-v1 (FP16 baseline). AWQ build: w/ act-quant on, group_size=64, per-channel scale, matmul rounding=nearest. Serving config: dedicated-prod-pool-2, batch_timeout=8ms.
maya: any chance this is batching interaction? group=64 seems large for our token-length distribution.
zara: logs show repeat pattern in token stream — generator emits same token id for 8-12 steps. snippet: 
```
[2025-11-02T14:08:12Z] req=0x7f2a: step=24 token=1293 "the"
[2025-11-02T14:08:12Z] req=0x7f2a: step=25 token=1293 "the" -> KV_CACHE_MISS
[2025-11-02T14:08:12Z] req=0x7f2a: step=26 token=1293 "the" -> loop_count=3
[... repeated ...]
```
zara: also seeing a spike in host-side memcpy around act-quant path right before the loop.
devon: can you paste eval diffs? is this a quality regression or just instability?
zara: quick eval on held-out prompts: 
- FP16 baseline (prod): LAMBADA acc=0.724, MMLU macro=0.512
- AWQ g=64, act-quant=on: LAMBADA acc=0.699 (-0.025), MMLU=0.495 (-0.017)
- AWQ g=32, act-quant=on: LAMBADA acc=0.716 (-0.008), MMLU=0.506 (-0.006)
- AWQ g=64, act-quant=off: LAMBADA acc=0.719 (-0.005), MMLU=0.509 (-0.003)
zara: so accuracy drop larger at g=64 with act-quant. stability visibly worse at g=64.
liam: interesting — suggests interaction between group quantization granularity and activation quant path. Could be numeric underflow/overflow during KV update when many tokens are grouped.
maya: quick mitigation: roll config to group_size=32 on the dedicated pool, and disable act-quant for the moment. Can we do a canary of those two knobs separately?
ops-bot: deploy event: rollback-config(group_size=32) started by @maya for service dedicated-prod-pool-2 at 2025-11-02T14:11:03Z :hammer_and_wrench:
liam: +1 on canary. Also add per-request token-entropy and kv-cache-sequence checks to tracing so we can detect early looping.
zara: doing that now. added metric: seq_repeat_rate, kv_miss_ratio, act_quant_scale_hist.
devon: for root cause, can we repro locally with a synthetic workload? i'd like to run long-run sampling for 2h with group=64 to capture stateful drift.
zara: queued a runner: `./runners/sample_long.sh --model open-13b --quant awq --group 64 --act-quant --duration 2h --log-step 10`
liam: also add a microbenchmark that toggles group boundary conditions: group_size=48,56,60,64,72 to see threshold behavior.
maya: if repro stable, plan: (1) revert prod to g=32 + act-quant off, (2) run telemetry + local 2h run, (3) test a patched act-quant code path with saturating clamp + small bias correction, (4) re-eval accuracy on full eval suite.
zara: noted. temporary rollback executed — request success, traffic shifted over 30s. early smoke looks better (no repeating tokens in 10m of traffic).
liam: thanks. follow-ups: add automatic alert when seq_repeat_rate > 0.02 for 5m, and add a configured fallback to FP16 variant on repeated failures.
devon: collect memory traces too — if memcpy spikes align with loops that's a strong signal for host/device synchronization problem.
maya: can someone open a short postmortem-style thread after we finish investigation with root cause and patch notes? keep concise. :memo:
zara: will compile logs + numeric diffs and post back here. rough ETA 24-36h. :eyes:
liam: thanks — very helpful. tagging infra team once we have the memory traces.
ops-bot: monitoring: alert cleared for dedicated-prod-pool-2 at 2025-11-02T14:25:10Z :white_check_mark:
